name: SiteHeader
description: Marketing/site header: sticky bar with brand, horizontal navigation with prefix-aware active states, right-aligned actions and a mobile drawer.
designIntent: Marketing sites repeat brand/nav/actions/mobile-menu wiring with custom active matching. SiteHeader standardizes the bar, handles /docs matching /docs/components, and stays router-agnostic via linkComponent.

props.name: brand
props.description: Brand slot (logo/lockup), wrapped in a link to /.

props.name: match
props.description: Prefix highlights parents of the current route; exact only identical hrefs.

props.name: mobileActions
props.description: Actions rendered inside the mobile drawer; defaults to `actions`.

props.name: linkHrefProp
props.description: Prop used to pass the destination to linkComponent: href for anchors/Next Link, to for react-router.

props.name: brandLabel
props.description: Accessible name for the brand link.

props.name: navLabel
props.description: Accessible name for the desktop navigation landmark.

props.name: mobileNavLabel
props.description: Accessible name for the mobile navigation landmark.

props.name: sticky
props.description: Pin the bar to the top.

props.name: mobileLabel
props.description: Title of the mobile navigation drawer.

antiPatterns.title: Don't use it for admin rails
antiPatterns.explanation: Vertical app navigation belongs in Sidebar + AppShell.
